premises.text: Electrical lighting is responsible for significant CO2 emissions and global electricity consumption
premises.evidence_span: Electrical lighting is responsible for 1.7 billion tons of CO2 emissions. It's 15% of global electricity consumption.

premises.text: Light pollution affects a large percentage of the global population
premises.evidence_span: more than 80% of humans are affected by light pollution.

premises.text: Nature has developed sustainable solutions for light production over billions of years
premises.evidence_span: nature has been through 3.8 billion years of research and development to find the most sustainable solution.

premises.text: Bioluminescent organisms can inspire sustainable lighting solutions
premises.evidence_span: glowworms, fireflies and more than 80% of marine organisms know exactly how to produce light biologically.

premises.text: Bioluminescent materials can reduce environmental impact and improve wellness
premises.evidence_span: to reduce the environmental impact, to improve wellness thanks to the quality of this natural light.

premises.text: Bioluminescent lighting can offer new design possibilities in the lighting industry
premises.evidence_span: to offer a lot of new design possibilities to revolutionize the lighting industry.

premises.text: Bioluminescent lighting can be used in various applications, including temporary and continuous lighting systems
premises.evidence_span: The first one is called Glow Event, and it's an ephemeral light to light temporal spaces, and it can light up to one week. The second one is Pipelight. It's a continuous lighting system.

premises.text: Bioluminescent lighting can enhance public spaces and urban environments
premises.evidence_span: bioluminescence will replace electric lighting in the landscape to give visibility to enhance, in public areas, on building facades, on parks and gardens.

premises.text: The production of bioluminescent light can be achieved through engineered bacteria
premises.evidence_span: we synthesize some genes coding for bioluminescence inside squids. Then we insert into lab-grown bacteria.

premises.text: The bioluminescent production process can utilize waste as nutrients
premises.evidence_span: we feed our microbes with waste coming from different kinds of industries.

premises.text: The company aims to disrupt the traditional lighting value chain
premises.evidence_span: our biotech solution is here to disrupt the entire light value chain.

premises.text: Partnerships with energy providers can help scale the bioluminescent lighting solution
premises.evidence_span: we are partnering with energy providers. So we license to them our technology, and they operate the system.

premises.text: The company has achieved significant sales and visibility in a short time
premises.evidence_span: we've managed, after only one year, to build this Glow Event product. And now, in two years, we've sold more than 6,000 units for light installations.

premises.text: Events can raise consumer awareness and visibility for the bioluminescent lighting solution
premises.evidence_span: events are great because they educate people, they raise consumer awareness, and they're also a good way to gain visibility.

premises.text: The company is focused on R&D to meet market needs
